name: Novastart
description: Novastart is an operating system built around an infinite canvas for apps, shared canvases, and AI agents. Individuals and teams can organize work visually, collaborate on shared canvases, and work alongside AI agents in the same workspace instead of being limited to separate windows. Novastart is built with Rust and offers a Free plan, Pro at $10/month, and Team at $20/month. Agents are billed per use at $0.02, from credit packs of $25 or more. The bootstrapped company is based in Los Angeles, California, USA, and was founded in January 2025.
